notes:
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and reported, but the save flow does not open or update the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-10: Tag-entry fields are plain comma-separated inputs with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-21: Bulk actions accept only explicitly selected IDs; there is no action over every result matching the current filter.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved views preserve a search expression and required tags, but provide no dedicated excluded-tag criteria.
REF-BM-30: Netscape import preserves titles and folder-derived tags but ignores ADD_DATE, so original dates are lost.
REF-BM-32: Default sorting and font size are configurable, but the displayed-item count is fixed and not adjustable.
